title: DOM Construction
definition: The Document Object Model (DOM) is an object-oriented representation of the web page. The browser parses HTML bytes into characters, characters into tokens, tokens into nodes, and nodes into the DOM tree.
simpleExplanation: The DOM is a family tree of your HTML. The <html> tag is the grandparent, <body> is the parent, and <div> tags are the children.
